final_wiki.answer-Q-2626:
Q-2626: How many days from 2021-07-18 to 2021-10-19 (count end date, not start date)?

Answer: 93 days.

Calculation: 2021 is not a leap year. Day-of-year Oct 19 = 292, Jul 18 = 199. Difference = 292 - 199 = 93. This counts the end date and excludes the start date.
